requirements.title: Structure components are derived-type object parts referenced by object designators and may be scalar or arrays
requirements.definition: A structure component is part of an object of derived type. It can be referenced by an object designator, and the component denoted by the designator may be scalar or array-valued. Formation of the data-ref, array element, array section, and component definitions remains with R911-R913, 7.5, 9.5, and 9.6 as applicable.

requirements.title: A part reference is a part name with optional section subscripts and optional image selector
requirements.definition: A part-ref consists of a part-name, optionally followed by a parenthesized section-subscript-list, and optionally followed by an image-selector. requirements.definition: In an R911 data-ref chain, each part-name except the rightmost shall be of derived type. The rightmost part-name may be intrinsic or derived subject to the context and other constraints.

requirements.definition: If the rightmost part-name of an R911 data-ref is of abstract type, the data-ref shall be polymorphic. Nonabstract rightmost part-names are not constrained by C911, and other rules own abstract type definition and polymorphic declaration syntax.

requirements.definition: The leftmost part-name in an R911 data-ref shall be the name of a data object. It is not a component name relative to an implicit receiver, a type name, a procedure name, or another nonobject entity.

requirements.title: A part reference subscript list accounts exactly for the rank of its part name
requirements.definition: When a section-subscript-list appears in a part-ref, the sum of the rank of that part-ref, the sizes of the arrays in each multiple subscript, and the number of scalar subscripts shall equal the rank of the part-name. The meanings of subscript, multiple-subscript, section-subscript, vector-subscript, and part-ref rank are supplied by p2 and 9.5.3.1-.2.

requirements.title: Part-reference rank is inherited from the part name or computed from section subscripts
requirements.definition: A part-ref of the form part-name has the rank of that part-name. A part-ref with a section-subscript-list has rank equal to the number of subscript triplets, plus the number of vector subscripts, plus the sizes of one of the arrays in each multiple section subscript. This definition feeds C913, C919, and data-ref rank in p3; it does not define the detailed validity of the subscript forms.

requirements.title: A data reference takes rank, base object, type and type parameters from specified part references
requirements.definition: The rank of a data-ref is the rank of its nonzero-rank part-ref if one exists, and zero otherwise. The base object is the data object named by the leftmost part-name. The type and type parameters of the data-ref are those of the rightmost part-name.

pending.rank-from-nonzero-part-ref: PENDING positive-control source: arr(:)%v or obj%a(:) with distinct integer values, using SIZE and SUM literal oracles to show data-ref rank follows the nonzero part-ref.
pending.rank-zero-when-no-nonzero-part-ref: PENDING positive-control source: obj%v scalar component assigned literal 14 and used where scalar rank is required. A neighboring array component prevents accidental whole-array observation.
pending.base-object-leftmost: PENDING source plan: data-ref obj%inner%v with obj declared and inner/v components; mutate two different objects and observe only the leftmost object's literal value. No address or storage association evidence is used.
pending.type-from-rightmost: PENDING positive-control source: derived object with INTEGER and CHARACTER rightmost components in separate data-refs, each used in a type-appropriate literal comparison. The preceding part has derived type in both cases.
pending.type-parameters-from-rightmost: PENDING positive-control source: rightmost CHARACTER component with known length, use LEN(obj%c) and compare to integer literal. The parent object's type parameters, if any, are distinct to prove rightmost ownership.

requirements.title: Pointer components determine when a multi-part data reference is a subobject of its base object
requirements.definition: A data-ref with more than one part-ref is a subobject of its base object if none of the part-names except possibly the rightmost is a pointer. If the rightmost part-name is the only pointer, the data-ref is a subobject of its base object in contexts that pertain to pointer association status, but not in other contexts. The dereferenced target of such a pointer component is not made a subobject by this rule.

pending.no-pointer-subobject: PENDING source plan: nonpointer nested component obj%inner%v is assigned and referenced with literal oracle, then used in a context whose owner depends on subobject status. The plan records the dependent owner rather than using address layout.
pending.nonrightmost-pointer-not-subobject: PENDING source plan: pointer component appears before the rightmost part in obj%p%v; observations use association status and assigned target literals only after defined association. The plan must not claim the target is a subobject of obj.
pending.rightmost-only-pointer-status-context: PENDING source plan: obj%p where p is the only pointer and rightmost is used in ASSOCIATED or pointer assignment status context with true/false literal branch oracle. This is only a status-context subobject claim.
pending.rightmost-only-pointer-dereference-conte: PENDING source plan: after associating obj%p with a target containing a known literal, dereference in value context and record that p5 does not make the target a subobject of obj. The oracle is the target literal, not storage location.

requirements.title: A structure component is a data reference
requirements.definition: The syntactic form of a structure-component is data-ref. C920 further narrows which data-refs are structure components by requiring more than one part-ref and no section-subscript-list on the rightmost part-ref.

pending.data-ref-form: PENDING positive-control source: obj%v satisfies R911 data-ref and is used as a structure component, assigned literal 3 and compared with literal 3.
pending.single-part-data-ref-not-component: PENDING source-classification plan: object name obj alone is a data-ref under R911 but fails C920 for structure-component; a paired obj%v reference has literal oracle. The plan records C920 as the exclusion owner.
pending.rightmost-section-list-not-component: PENDING source-classification plan: obj%a(1) and obj%a(:) end with a section-subscript-list and are classified under array element/section owners, not structure-component. Literal element or SUM oracles make the designators non-vacuous.

requirements.title: A structure component has multiple part references and no rightmost section-subscript list
requirements.definition: For an R913 structure-component, the data-ref shall contain more than one part-ref and the rightmost part-ref shall not have a section-subscript-list. A data-ref ending in a component name without a following subscript list can be a structure component even if earlier part-refs contain subscript lists.

pending.more-than-one-part-ref: PENDING positive-control source: obj%v with two part-refs assigned literal 6 and compared with literal 6. The same object name alone is used only as a control and not credited as a structure component.
pending.rightmost-no-section-list: PENDING positive-control source: object with array component parent selected earlier, e.g. arr(1)%v or obj%arr(1)%v where rightmost v has no list, assigned or initialized to distinct literal 19. The oracle proves the final component was selected.
pending.rightmost-section-list-rejected: PENDING source-classification/diagnostic plan: obj%a(1) where a is an array component is an array element, not a structure-component; in contexts requiring structure-component repair to obj%v or remove final list from a scalar component. Repaired execution uses literal oracle.
pending.earlier-section-list-allowed: PENDING positive-control source: ARRAY_PARENT(1:N)%SCALAR_FIELD-shaped case with nonzero-rank earlier part-ref and rightmost scalar field no list, using SUM over distinct field literals. This isolates that C920 forbids only the rightmost section-subscript-list.

requirements.title: A structure component is not referenced or defined before declaration of its base object
requirements.source: 9.4.2 p6 first sentence, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF152.
requirements.definition: A structure component shall be neither referenced nor defined before the declaration of the base object. This source-order restriction is stated in prose rather than as a numbered constraint; future diagnostics therefore need explicit diagnostic-policy treatment unless another numbered owner applies.

pending.reference-after-base-declaration: PENDING positive-control source: declare TYPE(t) :: obj before executable reference obj%v, assign obj%v=21, and compare with literal 21. The declaration precedes the reference in the same scoping unit.
pending.definition-after-base-declaration: PENDING positive-control source: declare base object before assignment obj%v=22, then print or compare literal 22. The assigned value changes from default to prove the defining context executed.
pending.reference-before-base-declaration: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source plan: attempt to reference obj%v in a specification or executable context before TYPE(t) :: obj appears; repair by moving the declaration before the reference and compare repaired execution to literal 21. If ordinary declaration-before-use rules diagnose first, record that owner.
pending.definition-before-base-declaration: PENDING diagnostic-policy/source plan: attempt obj%v=22 before declaring obj; repair by moving the declaration earlier and observe literal 22. The invalid source is not executed and this prose rule is not treated as an automatic numbered diagnostic.

requirements.title: A structure component has pointer status only from its rightmost part name
requirements.source: 9.4.2 p6 second sentence, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF152.
requirements.definition: A structure component is a pointer only if the rightmost part-name has the POINTER attribute. Pointer attributes on earlier part-names affect subobject status and association paths, but do not make a nonpointer rightmost component itself a pointer.

pending.rightmost-pointer-component: PENDING source plan: derived type with rightmost POINTER component p, use pointer association status inquiry with true/false literal branch after explicit association or NULL initialization. No address value or target storage content is the oracle.
pending.rightmost-nonpointer-after-pointer-paren: PENDING source plan: pointer parent component p associated with a target whose component v is nonpointer; reference obj%p%v after association and observe literal v, recording that the structure component v is not a pointer.
pending.earlier-pointer-does-not-propagate: PENDING diagnostic/control source: attempt a pointer-only operation on obj%p%v where only p is POINTER and v is not; repair by making rightmost v POINTER or by applying the operation to obj%p. Repaired source uses association-status or literal oracle without reading undefined targets.

review_rationale: Independent source review in doc/source_audits/batch_088.json reads all24 original 9.4.2 units and their73 fine units in full, verifies the census hashes and all502 grammar heads, and confirms faithful treatment of the part-ref chain. C909 and C910 keep the derived-type and component-of-declared-type conditions on all but the rightmost and leftmost part-names; C911 constrains only an abstract rightmost part-name; C912 requires a data-object leftmost name. C913 keeps the exact rank equation and C914 the cosubscript/corank equality, while C915 excludes C_PTR, C_FUNPTR and TEAM_TYPE only when some part-ref has an image selector and C916 requires a section-subscript-list only for an array part-name with an image selector. C917 and C918 retain their intrinsic-inquiry and type-parameter-inquiry exceptions, and C919 keeps both the single-nonzero-rank rule and the ALLOCATABLE/POINTER prohibition to its right. Array sections, subscripts and image selectors remain owned by 9.5.x and 9.6, and component definitions by 7.5.x. The three notes stay informative. All79 facets remain pending source plans; no case, execution, oracle or fixture approval is created.
